recentItems.title: How a GTA 6 NPC Picking Up Poop Became My Nemesis
recentItems.description:
Rockstar has created a world with infinite storytelling possibilities in GTA 6. Amongst all the wild action set pieces and bizarre side quests, 100s of NPCs live their own lives. Sometimes, you’ll never notice they’re there; sometimes you plough into them with a second thought, and sometimes you get wrapped up in a blood feud and a thirst for revenge with a guy who was picking up his dog's poop. Yes, that's very specific, and that's because it happened to me...

GTA 6's open world exists for you to find stories in, even when those stories don’t want to find you; all it takes is a little bit of exploring off the beaten track and, at least in my case, a willingness to get your hands dirty.

recentItems.title: Kazuhisa Wada: The Past, Present and Future of Persona | IGN30 Interview
recentItems.description:
From Persona 2: Eternal Punishment to the upcoming Persona 6, he's had a hand in shaping the spinoff-turned-mainline series. And with the career spanning over 30 years, we're excited to see how he and his team continue to shape the beloved RPG series. It was a pleasure to speak with creative producer and chief director of P-Studio with Atlus, Kazuhisa Wada, openly about his career in the early days of Maken X and Shin Megami Tensei 3: Nocturne to leading a team tasked with carrying Persona's legacy with Persona 6 and beyond with the next generation of developers and fans.

Read the full interview on IGN: https://www.ign.com/articles/the-past-present-and-future-of-persona-with-kazuhisa-wada-ign30-interview

#IGN #IGN30 #Persona

recentItems.description:
If reaching a six-star wanted level in GTA 6 is your goal, there are many methods available to you. But can you get there by firing just a single bullet? I had a theory that this was absolutely possible, so I spent hours in a fast-food joint to find out.

recentItems.title: 30 First Person Shooter Masterpieces You Need to Play
recentItems.description:
Part of the promise of video games is putting yourself in another world, taking control of a character and experiencing adventure and excitement through their eyes. No genre takes this premise quite so literally as the first-person shooter, a pillar of the medium and a fundamental building block of the entire industry. There’s no shortage of great first-person shooters, but a select few stand above the rest as high-water marks for the art form. 

From pioneers like Doom and Half-Life to multiplayer classics like Counter-Strike and Left 4 Dead 2, here are the 30 First-Person Shooter Masterpieces You Need to Play.

recentItems.title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection - Official Metal Slug 3, 4 & 5 Story Recap Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a recap of the story for Metal Slug 3, 4 and 5 ahead of the Metal Slug Ultimate Collection, the compendium of the classic Metal Slug games! 

The Metal Slug Ultimate Collection includes Metal Slug (1996), Metal Slug 2 (1998), Metal Slug X (1999), Metal Slug 3 (2000), Metal Slug 4 (2002), Metal Slug 5 (2003), Metal Slug Advance (2004), Metal Slug 6 (2006), Metal Slug 7 (2008), and the Metal Slug Location Test Build. 

Metal Slug Ultimate Collection will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in 2027.

recentItems.title: Symphony of War 2: Dominion - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Symphony of War 2: Dominion, an upcoming tactical RPG sequel to Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga. Symphony of War 2: Dominion will be available on PC (Steam and GOG) in 2027.

In Symphony of War 2: Dominion, lead a band of unlikely heroes through a world of political intrigue, betrayal, and tense, large-scale battles as opposing factions vie for control over a fallen Kingdom. Recruit powerful heroes and assemble a grand army, mixing and matching units from over 100 different classes to find the best squad combinations. Nurture conscripts into elite warriors, or hire mercenaries, deploying a range of tactics to meet every challenge.
